candidate.blueprint_locator: Physiological Integrity — Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies; safely manage medication-delivery devices and provide client education on parenteral therapy
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — insulin-pump infusion-site care
candidate.educational_objective: Teach insulin-pump users to inspect and rotate infusion sites and to change infusion sets according to the specific device manufacturer’s instructions rather than relying on a universal change interval.

options.A: I will inspect the infusion site for skin problems, rotate sites, and change the infusion set according to my pump manufacturer’s instructions.
options.B: I should keep using the same infusion site until insulin delivery stops because routine site rotation is unnecessary.
options.C: A pump infusion site does not need skin assessment because infection occurs only with insulin injections, not infusion sets.
options.D: I should use a fixed universal change interval even if the instructions for my specific infusion set recommend something different.

candidate.rationale: A is correct. The 2026 ADA Standards of Care identify appropriate care and rotation of insulin infusion sites as part of safe insulin administration and note pump-site infection and other skin complications as recognized problems. FDA guidance instructs pump users to follow pump-specific directions for when to change infusion sets and rotate infusion sites. B and C ignore known infusion-site complications. D is incorrect because change timing is device- and infusion-set-specific rather than a single universal interval for every product.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Safe insulin-pump use includes appropriate infusion-site care and rotation, recognition of site complications, and following manufacturer-specific instructions for infusion-set changes rather than a universal replacement interval.
candidate.source_document_title: Pharmacologic Approaches to Glycemic Treatment: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026; Insulin Pumps: Tips for Using Your Insulin Pump at Home
